Subject (in full) Re. allegations against J.D.C. 176 Liang Lyoh Liang.
(original report dated February 21, 1931)

Made by D.S.I. MacFarlane Forwarded by A. O'Dwyer. Insp.

Sir,
The above mentioned J.D.C. was before the Procurator
Koh Wei at the Shanghai Special District Court on the 28-1-31,
10-2-31, 19-2-31, 5-3-31 in answer to the allegations made against
him by the convict Tshoe Van Er.

With reference to the D.C's (J. & S.S.) remarks the
undersigned made further enquiries at the Municipal Gaol, also in
the vicinity of the Annam Road Market and at the Hospital where
Tshoe Van Er the convict's wife was receiving medical attention
during her confinement.

Mr. Wong the Assistant Municipal Advocate was also kept
in close touch with the case; but despite the numerous enquiries
nothing of an useful nature was elicited. The various witnesses
called in the case were again interrogated but nothing could be
obtained that would further the case one way or another.
Tshoe Van Er was interviewed at the Gaol and cross-questioned
regarding his statements but nothing was obtained from him that
could be substantiated by independent witnesses. One point was
brought out, namely that the convict was under the fear that his
wife would die whilst in hospital. This statement regarding his
apprehensions was corroborated by the fact that on the eve of his
arrest he bought dead-clothes and delivered them to the Hospital
Gate man to be used in the event of the woman dying that night.
It was also ascertained that at that time the woman was in such a
state of health as to warrant his fears. (It may be mentioned that
according to Tshoe's statement and allegation it was because his
wife was going to die that he borrowed the $150.00 to pay the
funeral expenses, and that it was this money that the J.D.C. 176
was supposed to have taken from him.)

(See F.I.R. B.W. 794)

静安寺捕房，
日期 1931年3月18日。

事由（全称）关于对警探第176号梁耀良（Liang Lyoh Liang）的指控。
（原报告日期为1931年2月21日）

由副督察麦克法兰（MacFarlane）呈报，经奥德怀尔（A. O'Dwyer）督察转呈。

先生，
上述警探于1931年1月28日、2月10日、2月19日及3月5日，在上海特区地方法院检察官柯伟（Koh Wei）面前出庭，以回应囚犯蔡万二（Tshoe Van Er）对其提出的指控。

鉴于该警探（江湾及小沙渡分区）的评语，具名人在市立监狱、安南路市场附近以及囚犯蔡万二之妻在分娩期间接受治疗的医院进行了进一步查询。

助理市检察官黄先生（Mr. Wong）也与此案保持密切联系；但尽管进行了多次查询，并未获得任何有用信息。本案传召的各证人再次受到讯问，但未能获得任何有助于推进本案的信息。
已在监狱内会见囚犯蔡万二，并就其陈述进行盘问，但从他那里未能获得任何可由独立证人证实的内容。其中有一点被提出，即该囚犯担心其妻子会在医院去世。关于其担忧的这一说法，得到了以下事实的佐证：在他被捕前夕，他购买了寿衣，并将其交给医院门卫，以备该妇女当晚去世时使用。此外还查明，当时该妇女的健康状况确实足以令其产生此种担忧。（值得一提的是，根据蔡的陈述和指控，他之所以借款150.00元，是因为其妻子即将去世，需支付丧葬费用，而据称正是这笔钱被警探第176号从他手中拿走。）

（参见初报 B.W. 794）

The convict's relatives were personally questioned by
the undersigned and also asked if they could in any way further
the cause of the convict. Every assistance was offered to them and
they were also informed that the case was being enquired into
without fear or favour to any party. No advantage of this was
taken however.

As stated above the witnesses etc. were before the
Procurator's Court on the dates mentioned and on the 17-3-31 the
Municipal Advocate received a notice of the decision of the
Procurator to the effect that he had found no grounds on which the
charge could be substantiated.

In the Shanghai Special Area District Court

Written Notice of Non-prosecution in re
Liang Nyoh Liang's (Detective No 176)
case.

The above named accused is suspected of an offence
of malfeasance in office. This Prosecutor has investigated
the facts of the case and decided not to institute a prose-
cution against him on the following grounds.

In the case at bar, the only suspicion against him is
by basing on the unsworn statement of the convict Tsai Van
Er who stated, "At the time of arrest, he (indicating the
accused) pointed to a gold pistol and took away from my
possession one gold finger ring, a pair of gold earrings,
and 150.00." Since there is no substantive facts to prove
the case, certainly in law, it is not allowed for a Court to
simply base on the unsworn statement to convict an innocent
person. The time of arrest given by the convict Tsai Van Er
was even contradictory. When he was in the Branch High Court,
he stated that he was arrested on the 10th of the 9th Moon
at 11 A.M. When he was before this Court, he stated that it
was on the 11th of the 9th Moon at 10 A.M. Not only the state-
ments are conflicting, but also the time given by the convict
conflicts with the record of the Police Station which was on
November 1, 1930 at 10 A.M. (the 11th of the 9th Moon). Then
it can be seen that his statements were untrue. No further

在上海特区地方法院

关于梁耀良（警探第176号）案件
不予起诉的书面通知。

上述被告涉嫌渎职罪。本检察官已调查本案事实，并基于以下理由决定不对他提起公诉。

在本案中，对他的唯一怀疑是基于囚犯蔡万二（Tsai Van Er）的未经宣誓的陈述，该陈述称：“在被捕时，他（指被告）指着一支金手枪，并从我的 possession 中拿走了一枚金戒指、一对金耳环和150.00元。”由于没有实质性事实来证明该案，在法律上，法院当然不允许仅凭未经宣誓的陈述就给无辜者定罪。囚犯蔡万二所述的逮捕时间甚至自相矛盾。当他在高等法院分院时，他说他是在农历九月初十上午11点被捕的。当他在本院出庭时，他说是在农历九月十一日上午10点。不仅陈述相互矛盾，而且囚犯给出的时间与警察局的记录（1930年11月1日上午10点，即农历九月十一日）相冲突。由此可见，他的陈述是不实的。没有进一步

pages.en:
testified, "as soon as I have alighted from the 5th Route Bus,
on Hadeon Road, I was arrested by the Bubblingwell Police Station
by the accused. We walked together on the road for about
quarter of an hour and I was searched for two or three minutes
in the Min You North Alleyway." It is of the opinion of this
Procurator that this could be impossible under the present
circumstances of this case. There is separating a distance
of three tram stops between the Min You North Alley and the Bubblingwell
Police Station. Under ordinary walking, it would take more ten
minutes to go from one place to another. It is human nature
that no one would be willing to be arrested into police station
to be punished by the law. Actually he would struggle on the
way. If it were as stated by Convict Van Er that he was searched
in the alleyway, it would be impossible to do it for only two
or three minutes and it would further be impossible to reach
the police station in quarter of an hour's time. Moreover,
as the streets are at all times filled with pedestrians, if any
incident happens on the road, a crowd would usually gather to
look at the side. Even though the accused was with an evil in-
tent to strip off the convict Tan Van Er's money and property,
he would never be able to do it in crowded street. More-
over, he dared not do it at a place only within a few minute's
walk to the Police Station. This is very clear.

Again, Convict Tan Van Er stated that ten minutes after
he was arrested into the police station, his friends Lee Kuo
pages.zh:
作证说，“我在赫登路（Hadeon Road）从5路公交车下车后，立即被静安寺捕房的被告逮捕。我们在路上一起走了大约一刻钟，并在民友北里（Min You North Alleyway）被搜身两三分钟。”本检察官认为，在本案目前的情况下，这是不可能的。民友北里与静安寺捕房之间相隔三个电车站的距离。按正常步行速度，从一个地方到另一个地方需要十分钟以上。人之常情是，没有人愿意被逮捕进警察局接受法律制裁。实际上，他会在路上挣扎。如果真如囚犯万二（Van Er）所述，他是在弄堂里被搜身的，那么不可能只花两三分钟，更不可能在一刻钟内到达警察局。此外，由于街道上总是挤满行人，如果路上发生任何事件，通常会有一群人聚集围观。即使被告怀有恶意企图剥取囚犯谭万二（Tan Van Er）的钱财和物品，他也不可能在拥挤的街道上得逞。此外，他不敢在距离警察局仅几分钟步行路程的地方这样做。这一点非常清楚。

再者，囚犯谭万二（Tan Van Er）称，在他被捕进入警察局十分钟后，他的朋友李国

Ker and Ts Tsung hsing visited him. This Prosecutor has
examined Ts ... ee, and they all testified that they had never
visited any police station in their whole life. The accused
arrested the convict as i Van Mr into the police station
on a public offence committed by him. He arrested him on
Hsdoen road on November 1, at 9.45 p.m. and they reached the
Police Station at 10 p.m. Since there was no delay on the road,
it is further clear that there was no such act as searching
the convict's property on the road. His conduct naturally
should be considered lawful. This notice of non-prosecution
is hereby given in accordance with Article 234 of the Code
of Criminal Procedure.
Dated March 9, 1931.

Pao Ci
Prosecutor of the Shanghai Special
District Court.
